brief: Read a fictional rental agreement’s deposit, notice and repair responsibilities.

en-US.scenario: Fictional US-dollar examples for "Rental Terms"; illustrative amounts, not current prices or product offers. No assumption of salary, bank ownership or spare income.

es-MX.scenario: Ejemplos ficticios en pesos mexicanos para "Lee las condiciones de renta"; montos ilustrativos, no precios vigentes ni ofertas. No se supone nómina, cuenta bancaria ni dinero sobrante.

pt-BR.scenario: Exemplos fictícios em reais para "Leia as condições do aluguel"; valores ilustrativos, não preços atuais nem ofertas. Sem supor salário, conta bancária ou dinheiro sobrando.

objective.observable_action: Read a fictional rental agreement’s deposit, notice and repair responsibilities.
objective.success_criterion: Complete the fresh-context transfer using only its visible information.

instruction.relevance: A signature turns stated conditions into obligations; inspect a fictional rental agreement before deciding.
instruction.misconception: A deposit replaces rent, verbal promises settle repairs, or notice can be ignored.
instruction.numeracy_support: Use only the visible fictional amounts and conditions; earlier arithmetic is preparation, not a hidden financial assumption.

evidence.reasoning: A fictional lease assigns repairs and notice duties. Read each clause; do not assume another contract uses identical rules.
The clause assigns roof repairs to the owner.
The deposit has a separate stated purpose.
Leaving alone does not satisfy the stated written-notice condition.
An agreed starting record distinguishes existing damage from later changes.
Conflicting promises leave the actual obligation unclear.
Reporting follows the stated process for this appliance fault.
